headline: **MLB Daily Recap**
article:
The New York Mets edged out the St. Louis Cardinals 5-4 in a close game, with Jared Young leading the Cardinals' offense. The Detroit Tigers dominated the Minnesota Twins, securing an 11-0 victory behind Keider Montero's strong pitching. The Miami Marlins secured shutout victories over both the Arizona Diamondbacks and the Pittsburgh Pirates.

Injuries continue to impact teams across the league. The Milwaukee Brewers placed Coleman Crow on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. The Colorado Rockies transferred Chase Dollander to the 60-day injured list with a right elbow strain. The Kansas City Royals placed Seth Lugo on the 7-day injured list with a concussion. The Athletics placed Brent Rooker on the 10-day injured list with a bone bruise in his left knee. The St. Louis Cardinals placed Ramón Urías on the 60-day injured list with right elbow lateral epicondylitis. The Philadelphia Phillies placed Adolis García on the 60-day injured list with a right latissimus dorsi tear. The Toronto Blue Jays placed Daulton Varsho on the 10-day injured list with left wrist inflammation. The Detroit Tigers transferred Javier Báez to the 60-day injured list with a right ankle sprain.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place. The Cleveland Guardians traded Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox for future considerations. The Chicago White Sox also traded Derek Hill and other considerations to the Philadelphia Phillies for Dylan Campbell and Jose Colmenares. The Milwaukee Brewers traded Jacob Waguespack to the Detroit Tigers.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Mets in Extra Innings**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets edged out the St. Louis Cardinals 5-4 in a close game. Jared Young led the Cardinals' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Rout Twins 11-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dominated the Minnesota Twins, securing a convincing 11-0 victory. Keider Montero led the way for the Tigers, pitching 6.1 innings with 4 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Diamondbacks 2-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a shutout victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with Tyler Phillips earning the win after 5.0 innings of scoreless relief.

top_news.title: **Rangers Take Down Royals 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a 4-2 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Corey Seager leading the offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI. Beck Way made a strong relief appearance, striking out 4 batters in 2 innings of work.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Pirates 8-3**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured an 8-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Liam Hicks and Kyle Stowers contributing to the impact hitters. Sandy Alcantara was a standout on the mound for the Marlins.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Orioles in 7-3 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 7-3 victory over the San Diego Padres, with several players making significant contributions to the win. Impact hitters for the Orioles included Manny Machado, Gavin Sheets, Gunnar Henderson, Samuel Basallo, and Tyler O'Neill, while Griffin Canning stood out as a key pitcher.

top_news.title: **Coleman Crow Placed on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-handed pitcher Coleman Crow has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain, effective retroactive to June 10, 2026.

top_news.title: **White Sox Acquire Nolan Jones in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox have made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring outfielder Nolan Jones from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for future considerations.
